references.text: Laban held a wedding feast for Jacob, illustrating the ancient custom of wedding feasts that Samson also followed
Isaac took Rebekah as his wife, another example of marriage practices in the patriarchal era
Samson's father and mother went with him down to Timnah, the context for this wedding journey
Samson's riddle at the wedding feast, which lasted seven days according to custom
The wedding at Cana where Jesus and his disciples were guests, showing the continuation of the wedding feast tradition
Jesus' parable about the king's wedding feast for his son, illustrating the importance of wedding feasts in biblical culture
